reason: The cited evidence shows Sn improved oxidation resistance in Nb-silicide alloys (E1) and suggests Sn is needed to suppress pest oxidation (E2), but neither passage addresses equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr, the formation of a Sn-enriched oxide scale on this alloy, or the preservation of its specific mechanical properties. The key premises about scale formation and mechanical property retention are unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: Sn addition improves oxidation resistance in Nb-silicide based alloys
Sn can suppress pest oxidation in refractory alloys
Sn-enriched oxide scale can be continuous and adherent
Minor Sn addition does not degrade mechanical properties of refractory alloys
